Writ petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be pleased to stay taking over of possession and demolition of the building until land acquired following the procedures under sections 3A, 3B, 3C,
3D, 3E of National Highways Act, 1956 and procedures under 2013 Right to Fair Compensation And Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013.

Grant 10 days to time to file arbitration claim under 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 and interlocutory application under section 17 of the Arbitration and Conciliation act, 1996 Suhara K vs Union Of India on 12 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150547390/
1 for complete acquisition of the building.

upon hearing the arguments of M/S. ASADU AHMMED CHULLINTE &
MEHNA IBRAHIM Advocates for the petitioners, SRI.MANU S., DEPUTY SOLICITOR GENERAL OF INDIA for R1 to R4 and R6 and of GOVERNMENT PLEADER for R5, R7,
R8, R9 and R10, the Court passed the following:
 SHOBA ANNAMMA EAPEN, J.
 ==================
 WP(C) Nos.34774/2022, 3551/2023, 30989/2022  & I.A.4/2023 in WP(C) No.30989/2023  ==================
 Dated this the 12th day of May, 2023  ORDER I.A.4/2023 in WP(C) No.30989/2023 Allowed.
WP(C) Nos.34774/2022, 3551/2023, 30989/2022 Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that access to the property has been blocked due to the construction.
Respondents 1 to 4 submits that if there is any obstruction to the access to the building, that will be cleared within one week and access will be provided to the building.
